name: coding-bug-fix-empty-input
description: Bug fix: diagnose and fix a parser crash on empty input

turns.userMessage: The test `crashes on empty input` in src/parser.test.ts is failing because parseQuery crashes on empty string input. Run the tests, find the root cause, and fix the parser to handle empty input gracefully instead of throwing.

mockResponses.text: Fixed: added empty input guard at the top of parseQuery(). When input is empty or whitespace-only, it returns a default Query instead of crashing. The test should now pass — empty input produces `{command:'', args:[], raw:''}` instead of throwing.
